title: Split simplicial attachment of a given relative boundary cover
statement: Let X be a scheme, K a simplicial etale X-scheme, A a finite split replacement stage through n, and Q boundary data for A [def-weil-pbc-finite-split-replacement-stage]. Suppose N is a finite coproduct of qcqs etale X-schemes with locally finitely presented, quasi-compact and quasi-separated structure maps. Suppose b:N to Q.M is surjective and g:N to K_(n+1) satisfies every lower boundary compatibility equation with A.f. Then A extends to a replacement stage B through n+1, whose restriction is exactly A. No hypercover condition on K is assumed.

source.place: 0DAV, construction of the split extension and simplicial composition check; 01GJ, refinement naturality.

proof.text: Apply the split-data theorem to the explicitly constructed attachment of the prescribed boundary cover. Obtain U with its equality to the attached functor and its exact restriction to A.U.

Use the proved attachedRefinement to construct the map from U to K, transporting its source along the functor equality. This uses the boundary equation on V and the proved naturality on all old summands.

Construct the replacement stage B from U and this refinement. Stage structure extensionality reduces restriction equality to equality of underlying finite split data and refinement maps. The former is supplied by the data theorem. The latter follows from functoriality of equality transports and attachedRefinement_restrict.

proof_origin.place: 0DAV and 01GJ: explicit attached functor and refinement, with only finite split and matching data supplied separately.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_replacement_stage_of_boundary_cover
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (K : SimplicialObject X.Etale)
    {n : ℕ} (A : FiniteSplitReplacementStage K n) (Q : ReplacementBoundary A.U)
    (N : X.Etale) (b : N ⟶ Q.M)
    (g : N ⟶ K.obj (op (SimplexCategory.mk (n + 1))))
    (hc : Surjective b.left)
    (hf : ∃ (k : ℕ) (V : Fin k → X.Etale) (ι : ∀ i, V i ⟶ N),
      Nonempty (IsColimit (Cofan.mk N ι)) ∧
        ∀ i, CompactSpace (V i).left ∧ QuasiSeparatedSpace (V i).left ∧
          LocallyOfFinitePresentation (V i).hom ∧ QuasiCompact (V i).hom ∧
            QuasiSeparated (V i).hom)
    (hcomp : ∀ (Δ : SimplexCategory.Truncated n)
      (θ : Δ.obj ⟶ SimplexCategory.mk (n + 1)),
      b ≫ Q.π Δ θ ≫ A.f.app (op Δ) = g ≫ K.map θ.op) :
    ∃ B : FiniteSplitReplacementStage K (n + 1), B.restrict n (Nat.le_succ n) = A
